mapper.sql: j.id, j.document_type, j.requested_by, j.idempotency_key, j.context::text AS context, array_to_string(j.source_ids, ',') AS record_ids, j.status, j.total_count, j.processed_count, j.skipped::text AS skipped, j.error_code, j.created_at, j.finished_at, j.expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.document_render_jobs j WHERE j.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM public.document_render_jobs j WHERE j.requested_by=#{requestedBy} AND j.idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
SELECT count(*) FROM public.document_render_jobs WHERE requested_by=#{requestedBy} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.document_render_jobs(id,document_type,requested_by,idempotency_key,context,source_ids,status,total_count,created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{documentType},#{requestedBy},#{idempotencyKey},CAST(#{context} AS jsonb),string_to_array(#{recordIds},',')::uuid[],'QUEUED',#{totalCount},#{now}) ON CONFLICT (requested_by, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT o.part_no, o.file_id, o.record_count, f.size_bytes, f.storage_provider, f.storage_key, f.checksum FROM public.document_render_job_outputs o JOIN public.files f ON f.id=o.file_id WHERE o.job_id=#{jobId} ORDER BY o.part_no
mapper.update: UPDATE public.document_render_jobs SET status='FAILED', error_code='ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED', lock_token=NULL, locked_until=NULL, finished_at=#{now}, expires_at=#{expiresAt}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE status='RUNNING' AND locked_until < #{now} AND attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts}
mapper.select: UPDATE public.document_render_jobs j SET status='RUNNING', lock_token=#{lockToken}, locked_until=#{leaseUntil}, attempt_count=j.attempt_count+1, started_at=COALESCE(j.started_at, #{now}), row_version=j.row_version+1 WHERE j.id = ( SELECT c.id FROM public.document_render_jobs c WHERE (c.status='QUEUED' OR (c.status='RUNNING' AND c.locked_until < #{now})) AND c.attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) RETURNING j.id, j.attempt_count, j.document_type, j.requested_by, j.context::text AS context, array_to_string(j.source_ids, ',') AS record_ids
mapper.update: UPDATE public.document_render_jobs SET template_version_id=#{templateVersionId}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_token=#{lockToken} AND status='RUNNING'

UPDATE public.document_render_jobs SET processed_count=#{processed}, skipped=CAST(#{skipped} AS jsonb), locked_until=#{leaseUntil}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_token=#{lockToken} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE public.document_render_jobs SET locked_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_token=#{lockToken} AND status='RUNNING'

UPDATE public.document_render_jobs SET status=#{status}, error_code=#{errorCode}, processed_count=#{processed}, skipped=CAST(#{skipped} AS jsonb), lock_token=NULL, locked_until=NULL, finished_at=#{now}, expires_at=#{expiresAt}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_token=#{lockToken} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM public.document_render_jobs WHERE status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.files WHERE id IN #{fileId}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.document_render_jobs SET status='EXPIRED', row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED')
